name: compass-mobile
description: Phase 4: Compass on iPhone, iPad and Android (Capacitor 8): a shell around compass.knocturnlabs.com. Kept apart from the web app so its dependencies never reach the Worker's build.

scripts.open: LANG=en_US.UTF-8 cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.build:sim: LANG=en_US.UTF-8 cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.build:android: LANG=en_US.UTF-8 cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
